brief.title: Local SEO agency introductions
brief.description: One free researched example and five additional US/Canadian local SEO agency profiles, with published business contacts, existing reporting workflows and a tailored geographic-ranking comparison.
brief.exclusions: Exclude duplicate domains and inferred contacts. Preserve agencies' existing tools and reporting services.

document.operator_note: Original case C0BTTA66TK3/1791868496.616779. Original buyer offer from brycembusiness2@gmail.com to support@maprank.so. Free Pro Local Builder profile and five additional distinct profiles for US$20 total. Existing parent Local SEO Bot business is explicit; no unsupported claim of zero customers. Source-qualified agency research only; agency outreach is outside this delivery.

document.demand: The agency offers recurring SEO for local businesses, including Google Maps work and monthly reports showing work performed and ranking changes. Its published service tiers include keyword tracking, and its founding team spans three distinct local markets.
document.fit: Compare one consenting client's priority keyword across a neighborhood grid, then place the resulting read-only branded report beside the agency's existing monthly report. The three service regions offer different city densities, so use an explicit location, grid spacing and scan date. The comparison should establish whether geographic detail and client access improve the current reporting workflow.
document.contact_instructions: Published business email: hello@prolocalbuilder.com. Business phone: 408-908-9940. The SEO page names founders Kyle in Appleton, Cesar in San Jose and Zac in Las Vegas.
document.geography: Wisconsin, San Francisco Bay Area and Las Vegas, United States
document.opening_message: Your SEO plans already include local rankings and a monthly account of what changed. Would one client keyword mapped across its actual service area be useful to compare with that report—using the same locations and date, with a client-readable link?
document.status_note: Official service and business-contact sources reviewed on 13 October 2026. A suggested product comparison is a research assessment, to be confirmed with the agency.
document.operator_note: Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791868496.616779. First-party agency service and contact sources reviewed; each profile is a potential product fit. No agency has been approached. https://www.prolocalbuilder.com/seo

document.demand: The agency describes local map-pack tracking, location-specific keyword visibility, changes in position, competitor comparisons and monthly reporting. It also monitors citations as part of its broader local SEO service.
document.fit: Compare MapRank's grid view and read-only client report against one existing location-specific keyword report. Match search phrase, business location, coordinates and observation date. Assess client readability and the effort needed to manage recurring scans across the roster, keeping citation monitoring and broader analytics in their existing systems.
document.contact_instructions: Published business email: hello@heldermedia.com. Business phone: +1 226-780-3085. Official contact page lists 505 Queensway West, Unit 9B, Simcoe, Ontario.
document.opening_message: Your tracking service already covers map-pack visibility and location-specific keywords. Would a matched grid report for one current account help you compare neighborhood detail and the client-facing report with your existing monthly workflow?
document.status_note: Official service and business-contact sources reviewed on 13 October 2026. A suggested product comparison is a research assessment, to be confirmed with the agency.
document.operator_note: Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791868496.616779. First-party agency service and contact sources reviewed; each profile is a potential product fit. No agency has been approached. https://heldermedia.com/seo-services/seo-tracking-and-monitoring/ | https://heldermedia.com/contact/

document.demand: Watson & Co serves HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping and related home-service companies. Its SEO page describes monthly keyword rankings, call tracking, Google Business Profile performance and organic traffic reports, and it limits each market to one client per trade.
document.fit: Use one approved home-service account to compare its priority search phrase across the actual service area. A geographically explicit report can sit alongside existing calls and GBP performance in the monthly conversation. Keep the client's territory and the agency's exclusivity commitments explicit; a map scan does not replace call attribution.
document.contact_instructions: Published general agency email: hello@watsonco.marketing, displayed as hello [at] watsonco.marketing. Founder Matt Watson is named on the official About page. Business phone: 844-717-6024.
document.geography: Port Orange, Florida, United States; home-service clients
document.opening_message: Your monthly home-service reports already connect keyword rankings, GBP activity and calls. Would a neighborhood-by-neighborhood view of one client's priority search help compare map visibility within its agreed service area?
document.status_note: Official service and business-contact sources reviewed on 13 October 2026. A suggested product comparison is a research assessment, to be confirmed with the agency.
document.operator_note: Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791868496.616779. First-party agency service and contact sources reviewed; each profile is a potential product fit. No agency has been approached. https://watsonco.marketing/services/home-services-seo/ | https://watsonco.marketing/about/

document.demand: The agency combines websites, SEO and Google Business Profile management for home-service businesses. Its ongoing service includes monthly ranking, call and lead-volume reporting.
document.fit: Compare one contractor client's search phrase across several neighborhoods against its current rank report. Review how clearly the branded map communicates coverage and changes to the business owner. Keep calls and lead counts in the existing report and use a consistent scan configuration for any later comparison.
document.contact_instructions: Published business email: hello@razamarketing.com. Business phone: 205-567-8697. The agency's homepage identifies Panama City Beach and its home-service focus.
document.geography: Panama City Beach, Florida, United States; nationwide home-service clients
document.opening_message: You already report rankings, calls and lead volume to home-service clients. Would a branded map of one contractor's visibility across nearby neighborhoods be useful to compare with the ranking section of that report?
document.status_note: Official service and business-contact sources reviewed on 13 October 2026. A suggested product comparison is a research assessment, to be confirmed with the agency.
document.operator_note: Original supplier case C0BTTA66TK3/1791868496.616779. First-party agency service and contact sources reviewed; each profile is a potential product fit. No agency has been approached. https://razamarketing.com/

document.demand: The agency offers local SEO, citations, GBP improvements, photos and review support. Its service describes monthly keyword rankings and GBP impressions, calls and directions. Rank Math Pro is explicitly part of its existing SEO toolset.
document.fit: A map-grid comparison could complement its existing Rank Math Pro work with location-by-location visibility for one approved client. Review whether the map and read-only branded report add a useful client explanation beyond the current keyword and GBP metrics, with consistent search phrase, coordinates and date.

document.demand: The agency offers local search visibility with ranking maps, keyword and citation tracking, GBP statistics and monthly reports. Its portfolio includes local construction and home-service businesses in Northern Virginia.
document.fit: Start with its existing ranking-map workflow and compare one approved client over the same coordinates, spacing, keyword and observation date. Evaluate report readability, the effort to update a client roster and the recurring scan budget. A different tool is useful only if the comparison improves a concrete part of the current operation.

customer_packages.title: MapRank — free agency example
customer_packages.instructions: Start with the HTML agency profiles and editable CSV. Each source link supports the published business contact or existing local SEO service. Suggested openings and product comparisons are research judgments. Confirm the agency’s current tool, an approved client, keyword, geography and reporting cadence. Keep existing reporting during a like-for-like comparison. Five additional profiles cost US$20 total, with one correction or replacement within seven days for an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch.
